# Pseudo-bulk markers {#sec-deseq2}

Per time point, aggregate unnormalised counts by sample and cell type,
filter with `edgeR::filterByExpr()`, and fit `DESeq2` as in
[06_02_deseq2_*.R](https://github.com/bastienchassagnol/GastroDeconv2FateMap/blob/main/scripts/06_02_deseq2_biological_exploration_transcriptomic_differential_analyses.R).

Template: `scripts/04_01_feature_selection_pseudobulk_deseq2.R`.

# Genetic / Pareto panels {#sec-ga}

Refine the shortlist with the all-versus-all criteria in DeCovarT
`vignettes/supp-S6-feature-selection.qmd`: minimise
$\kappa_2(\boldsymbol{\mu}_{\mathcal{G}})$ and mean overlap with
`mco::nsga2()` (NSGA-II); optional scalar `GA` / `GenSA`.

Template: `scripts/04_02_feature_selection_genetic_algorithm.R`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# mco::nsga2(fn = bi_objective_func, idim = n_candidates, odim = 2, ...)
```
:::


Keep several non-dominated panels; do not report a single arbitrary knee
as *the* signature until nested, leakage-free validation exists.
